infoPlist._comment_encryption: The SSH module bundles OpenSSL and does general-purpose encryption, so this is 'true' — 'false' would be a false declaration. Standard/mass-market crypto (SSH, TLS) qualifies for the export exemption; ANSWER the export-compliance questions in App Store Connect accordingly at submission (or supply the self-classification report). See docs/app-store.md.
infoPlist._comment_ats: The only cleartext this app makes is to 127.0.0.1, the local end of the SSH tunnel — the relay is https. So the exception is the narrow one: NSAllowsLocalNetworking covers loopback and leaves ATS enforced for every other host. It was NSAllowsArbitraryLoads while a typed tailnet address was a way in (no fixed domain could be whitelisted); that transport is gone, and a blanket exception is the hardest kind to justify at review. See docs/app-store.md.

plugins.photosPermission: Shahi attaches a photo from your library to send to the agent you are talking to.

plugins.cameraPermission: Shahi uses the camera to scan the pairing code your server prints.
plugins._comment: Scanning only: no microphone string and no RECORD_AUDIO, so the app never claims a permission it has no use for.
